name: Brea Mall
description: Brea Mall is a premier two-level enclosed regional shopping center located in Orange County, California, managed by Simon Property Group. The mall features major department store anchors including Macy's, Nordstrom, and JCPenney, along with a diverse mix of specialty retailers, dining options, and entertainment venues. With its convenient location near major freeways and affluent residential areas, Brea Mall serves as a key retail destination for the greater Los Angeles metropolitan area.
demographics: Serves affluent residential areas in Orange County with high median household incomes and strong retail spending patterns in the Brea, Fullerton, and Placentia communities.
summary: Brea Mall is a premier enclosed regional shopping center in Orange County featuring department store anchors and over 175 specialty stores.
